description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentences across various categories, with the categories listed on the horizontal axis in the order: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science. The vertical axis is labeled "Sentences (K)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, with tick labels at intervals of 200. Each category is represented by a red bar, with the height corresponding to the number of sentences in thousands. The bars are labeled with their respective values, showing that News has the highest value at 902K, followed by Administrative at 525K, and Non-fiction at 190K, while the lowest values are seen in Law at 23K and Religion at 50K, with the smallest being 2K. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bar. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the sentence distribution across the different categories.
